fields.System.Title: INB-308 — Split a putaway across multiple destinations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a putaway operator, I want to put part of a pallet in one place and the rest in
another, so that stock that does not fit in one location can still be put away properly.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a task, when I confirm part of the quantity to one location, then a movement
  • is written for that part and the task remains open for the remainder.
  • - Given the remainder is confirmed elsewhere, then a second movement is written and the
  • task closes.
  • - Given a partially completed task, then the outstanding quantity is visible and the
  • source stock is still shown in receiving.
  • - Given every split, then the sum of the movements equals the original task quantity.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, stock_movement, stock_balance |
| Risks | Partially completed tasks abandoned, stranding stock in receiving ([doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
